if (is.null(params$temperature)) {
  temp_text <- "Temperature calculation was not requested"
} else {
  temp_text <- paste0(
    "Historical temperature data was taken from [WorldClim version 2.1](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html). The average annual temperature with the ecosystem between 1970 and 2000 was ", round(mean(params$temperature$mean), 1), "°C. The average monthly temperature patterns are shown in the graph below:"
    )
}

**Temperature:** `r temp_text`

```{r temperature, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,  fig.align = "center", out.width = '100%', fig.height=3, eval = !is.null(params$temperature)}
temp_avg <- params$temperature

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  # --- Interactive Plotly ---
  t_plot <- plot_ly(temp_avg, x = ~month) %>%
        add_ribbons(
          ymin = ~min_smooth,
          ymax = ~max_smooth,
          line = list(color = 'transparent'),
          fillcolor = 'firebrick',
          opacity = 0.1,
          name = "95% range"
        ) %>%
        add_lines(
          y = ~mean_smooth,
          line = list(color = 'red', width = 2),
          name = "Mean"
        ) %>%
        layout(
          xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
          yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)")
        )

  t_plot

} else {
  # --- Static ggplot for PDF/Word ---
   t_plot <- ggplot(temp_avg, aes(x = month, group=1)) +
  # smoothed ribbon
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_smooth, ymax = max_smooth),
              fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +

  # smoothed mean line
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_smooth), color = "blue", size = 1) +
    labs(title = "Average Monthly Temperature",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Temperature (°C)")+
    theme_classic() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype=5, linewidth=0.5, color="grey50"))

   t_plot
}
```
